plugins.name: agency-hub
plugins.description: Install first — bootstraps a git-versioned instance workspace (config/, brand/, squads/) via agency-setup. Marketplace management is v2 — designed, deferred.

plugins.name: brand-creative
plugins.description: Complete brand practice in one install — practice-setup interview, brand-voice lifecycle, and brand-guide visual identity. Writes to the instance brand/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/brand/.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering practice — architecture (solution, adr), epic design, implementation, code review, merge requests, documentation passes, debugging, and technical debt. Delivery skills follow docs/work/{epic}/ conventions; install with Frontend Engineer agent or standalone.

plugins.name: delivery-practice
plugins.description: Complete delivery practice in one install — practice-setup interview, product strategy, backlog and sprint cadence, validation, and operational skills. Two personas (Product Manager, Delivery Lead), one owned skill library.

plugins.name: content-marketing
plugins.description: Complete content practice in one install — practice-setup interview, editorial calendar, social curation, media analysis, and CMS seed drafting. Two personas (Content Strategist, Content Writer), one owned skill library. Reads brand voice from resolved brand path; invokes delivery-practice for backlog and research.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: Minimal UX practice in one install — practice-setup interview and wireframe skill for low-fidelity layout and interaction specs. Writes to the instance design/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/design/.

plugins.name: search-optimisation
plugins.description: Complete search and technical SEO practice in one install — practice-setup interview, keyword research, technical audits, and content SEO review. One persona (SEO Specialist), one owned skill library. Invokes delivery-practice for competitive brief.

plugins.name: frontend-engineer
plugins.description: Agentic frontend engineer role: React/Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Base UI. Builds and maintains UI, client state, and styling, reading the target repo's own AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md for conventions before making changes. Does not own data-model/backend (Payload collections, schema, infra).

plugins.name: senior-frontend-engineer
plugins.description: Agentic senior frontend engineer role: peer code reviewer for React/Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, and accessibility. Reviews diffs against design docs and acceptance criteria; produces blocking/non-blocking verdicts. Does not write code or approve in hosted UIs.

plugins.name: principal-frontend-engineer
plugins.description: Agentic principal frontend engineer / tech lead — final technical gate on open PRs/MRs after peer review. Validates React/Next.js architecture, security, and acceptance-criteria coverage. Maps to delivery-review tech-lead gate.

plugins.name: qa-engineer
plugins.description: Agentic QA engineer — validates changes after CI: deploy QA workspace, run automated tests, AC-driven exploratory pass, document defects. Maps to delivery-qa crew flow.

plugins.name: principal-architect
plugins.description: Agentic principal architect — system architecture (solution.md), ADRs, epic-level design, and documentation alignment. Owns the Architecture track upstream of implementation.

plugins.name: webops-engineer
plugins.description: Agentic webops engineer — CI/CD, deployment, dependency hygiene, and platform health. Resolves frontend-engineer infra boundary.
